name: weave
description: Resolves Git merge conflicts at the level of functions, classes, and keys instead of lines, through a merge driver, CLI, and MCP server, for teams merging parallel agent branches.

skills.name: Entity-Level Merge
skills.description: Merges code by parsed functions, classes, and keys so parallel edits to different entities no longer conflict.

skills.name: Verified Landing
skills.description: Merges a branch, checks the result for structural problems, and optionally runs a verify command before publishing.

skills.name: Conflict Explain and Check
skills.description: Explains each conflicted hunk with the reason it was refused and verifies the working tree against the three merge stages.
